Universiti Malaya - WIX1002 Fundamentals of Programming
Group Project Marking Rubric

1. Program (60%)
   a. Correctness of output (25%)
   b. Code structure and comments (20%)
   c. Error handling (15%)
2. Report (25%)
   a. Flowcharts and pseudocode (15%)
   b. User guide (10%)
3. Presentation (15%)

Grade    Range
A        80% - 100%
B        65% - 79%
C        50% - 64%
